root.label: Structured bindings
root.note: One hidden variable e is initialized from the expression; the names refer into it.

children.label: The hidden variable e
children.note: Specifiers and ref-qualifiers you write declare e, not the names.

children.label: auto
children.note: e is a copy of the initializer, so writes through the names do not reach the source.

children.label: auto&
children.note: e aliases an lvalue; it cannot bind to a prvalue.

children.label: const auto& and auto&&
children.note: e binds to anything, including temporaries, without copying.

children.label: Array exception
children.note: Without a reference, an array initializer is copied element by element into an array e.

children.label: Three protocols
children.note: Chosen in order from E, the type of e without references.

children.label: Array
children.note: Names refer to elements; their count must equal the bound.

children.label: Tuple-like
children.note: Used whenever std::tuple_size<E> is complete with a value member.

children.label: Data members
children.note: All non-static members, accessible at the declaration since C++20, in one class.

children.label: Names, not variables
children.note: A binding is an alias with its own rules.

children.label: decltype
children.note: Gives the referenced type: int for a pair<int, int> binding even with auto&.

children.label: std::tie
children.note: Element types are references, so plain auto still aliases the tied variables.

children.label: Bit-fields
children.note: A binding can name a bit-field, which no reference can.

children.label: Lambda capture
children.note: Forbidden in C++17, allowed in C++20; bit-field bindings cannot be captured by reference.

children.label: Specifiers
children.note: static and thread_local since C++20; constexpr only from C++26; never inline.

children.label: Lifetime
children.note: Extension works through e, not through the names.

children.label: Direct binding extends
children.note: const auto& [a, b] = make(); keeps the temporary alive to scope end.

children.label: Returned references dangle
children.note: If the initializer returns a reference into a temporary, nothing is extended.

children.label: Tuple protocol
children.note: Specialize tuple_size and tuple_element and provide get.

children.label: Member get first
children.note: Used if member lookup finds a get template whose first parameter is a non-type parameter.

children.label: ADL-only free get
children.note: Otherwise get<i>(e) is found only by argument-dependent lookup.

children.label: Value category of e
children.note: e is passed as an lvalue if it is an lvalue reference, else as an xvalue.

children.label: C++26 additions
children.note: Implemented by GCC 16 in -std=c++26 mode.

children.label: Per-binding attributes
children.note: auto [a, b [[maybe_unused]]] = f(); attaches an attribute to one name.

children.label: As a condition
children.note: if (auto [ok, v] = f()) tests e as bool before the bindings are initialized.

children.label: Binding packs
children.note: auto [h, ...t] = x; introduces a possibly empty pack, only inside templates.
